arguments_prompt:
## delete_repeating_calendar_event

Delete an entire recurring calendar event series — every past, present, and future occurrence. Use only when the user has explicitly asked to cancel the whole recurring event. To cancel just one occurrence, use `delete_calendar_event` with the instance id instead.

### Arguments:

- **event_id** (required): The Google Calendar event ID of the recurring series. May be the base series id or any single instance id — both resolve to the same series.
- **cascade** (optional, default: false): Also delete linked children (reminders, sub-events) in the local repository.

### Example:
```json
{
  "tool_name": "delete_repeating_calendar_event",
  "arguments": {
    "event_id": "qgstjk55ji1tlbmm35hp59tcn8"
  }
}
```

metadata.planner_description: Delete an entire recurring event series. Use only when the user explicitly wants to remove every occurrence; otherwise use delete_calendar_event.
